title: Exploring Optimal Combinations: The Impact of Sequential Multimodal Inspirational Stimuli in Design Concepts on Creativity
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study investigates how the sequence of multimodal inspirational stimuli (text, images, virtual models) affects designers' creativity during the design conception phase. A platform called InspireMe was developed to present these stimuli in various sequences, and 36 novice designers participated in the study. The results show that the sequence of stimuli significantly influences creativity, with different impacts on sub-attributes of creativity. The study proposes a Creativity Demand-Matching Inspirational Interaction Strategy (CDI) and a 3C Framework for creativity stimulation platforms.
